title: Adversarial test against higher-order theories, outcome not yet reported

statements.text: Templeton World Charity Foundation project 0567, led by Biyu Jade He with David Chalmers and Ned Block from December 2020 to December 2023, tests recurrent processing theory against two higher-order theories, HOROR and PRM. First-order theories predict that the basis of conscious content lies in visual cortex, higher-order theories that it lies in prefrontal cortex. The project page lists no published outcome.
statements.falsification_criteria: The collaboration finds that conscious content tracks prefrontal rather than visual cortex activity, as higher-order theories predict.

sources.quote: Five such projects have been sponsored by the Templeton World Charity Foundation, including tests of GNWT, IIT, PP/NREP, and RPT.
